functions.name: BZ2_bzCompressInit
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompressInit ( bz_stream* strm, int blockSize100k, int verbosity, int workFactor )
functions.summary: Initialise a caller-owned bz_stream for compression: allocate the EState and three work arrays through bzalloc and enter the RUNNING state.

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Caller-owned stream. bzalloc/bzfree/opaque must be set or NULL before the call; other fields need not be initialised. Must not be moved or copied until BZ2_bzCompressEnd (back-pointer check, bzlib.c:414).

parameters.name: blockSize100k
parameters.meaning: Block size in units of 100000 bytes; also written into the stream header (compress.c:627).

parameters.name: verbosity
parameters.meaning: Diagnostic level for stderr. NOT range-checked here (bzlib.c:159-162); compared with >= thresholds 2,3,4.

parameters.name: workFactor
parameters.meaning: Effort before falling back to the fallback sort. 0 means 30 (bzlib.c:164); values above 100 behave as 100 in BZ2_blockSort (blocksort.c:1063-1064). Output is identical regardless of which sort runs.

functions.returns: BZ_OK on success, else an error code; strm->state is set only on BZ_OK.

errors.when: sizeof(int)!=4, sizeof(short)!=2 or sizeof(char)!=1 (bzlib.c:90-97, 157); checked first.
strm == NULL, blockSize100k outside 1..9, or workFactor outside 0..250 (bzlib.c:159-162).
bzalloc returned NULL for the EState (bzlib.c:169) or any work array (bzlib.c:181-187; partial allocations freed).
success.

preconditions: strm points to writable bz_stream; strm->bzalloc/bzfree are valid allocator functions or NULL.
*strm must stay at the same address until BZ2_bzCompressEnd (EState keeps a back-pointer, bzlib.c:170, checked at bzlib.c:413-414, 473-474).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: strm->state = new EState, mode RUNNING, sub-state INPUT, blockNo 1, combinedCRC 0 (bzlib.c:189-209).
On BZ_OK: total_in_lo32/hi32 and total_out_lo32/hi32 = 0 (bzlib.c:203-207).
next_in/avail_in/next_out/avail_out untouched.
If the parameter check passed, NULL bzalloc/bzfree have been replaced by default_bzalloc/default_bzfree in *strm (bzlib.c:165-166), even on BZ_MEM_ERROR.
On failure strm->state is unchanged.
side_effects: bzalloc(opaque, n, 1) for sizeof(EState), then n*4, (n+34)*4 and 65537*4 bytes, n = 100000*blockSize100k (bzlib.c:168-179): four calls on success; exactly one if the EState allocation fails (return at bzlib.c:169); all four if a work-array allocation fails, after which the non-NULL ones and the EState are bzfree-d (bzlib.c:181-187).
No I/O, no stderr output, no AssertH paths.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzCompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompress ( bz_stream* strm, int action )
functions.summary: Move data from next_in to compressed output at next_out and drive the RUNNING/FLUSHING/FINISHING/IDLE state machine (surface-area.md section 2.1).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Stream initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit and not ended; next_in/avail_in/next_out/avail_out describe caller buffers valid for the duration of the call (not retained).

functions.returns: A progress code (BZ_RUN_OK, BZ_FLUSH_OK, BZ_FINISH_OK, BZ_STREAM_END) or an error code. The final 'return BZ_OK' (bzlib.c:463) is unreachable.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:411-414).
RUNNING and action is BZ_RUN but no byte was consumed or produced (bzlib.c:425), e.g. avail_in == 0 with nothing pending (verified).
RUNNING and action is not BZ_RUN/BZ_FLUSH/BZ_FINISH (bzlib.c:439-440) (verified).
IDLE, i.e. after BZ_STREAM_END (bzlib.c:419-420).
FLUSHING and action != BZ_FLUSH, or avail_in differs from the value recorded at the flush request (bzlib.c:443-445).
FINISHING and action != BZ_FINISH, or avail_in changed (bzlib.c:453-455).
FINISHING and the call made no progress, e.g. avail_out == 0 while output is pending (bzlib.c:456-457) (verified).
RUNNING/BZ_RUN with progress (bzlib.c:424-425); or a flush completed, returning to RUNNING (bzlib.c:449-450), possibly in the same call that requested it (verified).
flush not yet complete (bzlib.c:447-448).
finish not yet complete (bzlib.c:458-459).
finish complete; stream now IDLE (bzlib.c:460-461), possibly in the same call that requested BZ_FINISH (verified).

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit (passing a decompression stream is not detected and is undefined).
While FLUSHING/FINISHING, avail_in must stay exactly as the library left it (bzlib.c:444, 454).
postconditions: next_in/avail_in/total_in_* advanced by bytes consumed; next_out/avail_out/total_out_* by bytes produced.
RUNNING+BZ_FLUSH records avail_in_expect=avail_in and enters FLUSHING; RUNNING+BZ_FINISH enters FINISHING (bzlib.c:428-438).
After a completed BZ_FLUSH, fewer than 32 bits of the last block remain in the internal bit buffer; the bytes emitted so far are not independently decodable (compress.c:657-666) (verified).
side_effects: stderr output when verbosity >= 2 (per block) and >= 3/4 (details) via BZ2_compressBlock/BZ2_blockSort.
May end in BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail (exit(3)) via internal assertions 1001-1007, 2001-2002, 3001-3007; reachability not established.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same stream concurrently; safe on distinct streams.

functions.name: BZ2_bzCompressEnd
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompressEnd ( bz_stream* strm )
functions.summary: Free all memory of a compression stream in any initialised state and set strm->state to NULL.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:471-474); so a second End returns BZ_PARAM_ERROR (verified).
memory released.

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit and not yet ended (a second End gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR because state is NULL, bzlib.c:471-474).
Any compression state is accepted (RUNNING, FLUSHING, FINISHING, IDLE).
postconditions: arr1, arr2, ftab and the EState passed to bzfree (bzlib.c:476-479); strm->state == NULL (bzlib.c:481). Other fields unchanged; pending output discarded.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompressInit
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompressInit ( bz_stream *strm, int verbosity, int small )
functions.summary: Initialise a caller-owned bz_stream for decompressing one stream; allocates only the DState (block arrays are allocated when the header is read).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Caller-owned stream with bzalloc/bzfree/opaque set or NULL. Must not move until End.

parameters.name: small
parameters.meaning: 1: low-memory decoder (2.5 bytes per block byte, slower); 0: fast decoder (4 bytes per block byte) (decompress.c:211-220).

functions.returns: BZ_OK on success, else an error code.

errors.when: platform type sizes wrong (bzlib.c:499).
strm == NULL, small not 0/1, or verbosity outside 0..4 (bzlib.c:501-503) (verified).
bzalloc for the DState failed (bzlib.c:509).
success.

preconditions: strm non-NULL and points to a writable bz_stream (NULL gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR, bzlib.c:501).
strm->bzalloc/bzfree/opaque set beforehand (bzalloc/bzfree may be NULL for the defaults); other fields need not be initialised.
*strm must stay valid and at the same address until BZ2_bzDecompressEnd (DState keeps a back-pointer, checked at bzlib.c:814-815, 867-868).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: strm->state = new DState with state BZ_X_MAGIC_1; totals zeroed; tt/ll16/ll4 NULL (bzlib.c:510-525).
NULL bzalloc/bzfree replaced by defaults (bzlib.c:505-506) once parameters are valid.
On any failure strm->state is unchanged and nothing remains allocated.
side_effects: One bzalloc of sizeof(DState). No I/O.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompress ( bz_stream* strm )
functions.summary: Consume compressed bytes from next_in and write decompressed bytes to next_out for exactly one bzip2 stream; checks block and combined CRCs (state machine in surface-area.md section 2.2).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Stream initialised by BZ2_bzDecompressInit, not ended. avail_out may be 0 (not checked).

functions.returns: BZ_OK (needs more input or output space), BZ_STREAM_END, or an error code.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:812-815). No avail_out check.
stream already ended (state BZ_X_IDLE) (bzlib.c:818) (verified).
first 3 bytes not 'BZh' or 4th not '1'..'9' (decompress.c:197-208) (verified).
bzalloc of tt or ll16/ll4 failed after the header (decompress.c:216, 219).
format violation (decompress.c checks listed in surface-area.md section 8.6), block CRC mismatch (bzlib.c:830-831), combined CRC mismatch (bzlib.c:847-848), or corrupt inverse-BWT walk (bzlib.c:823).
end-of-stream marker read, combined CRC matches, all output delivered (bzlib.c:843-849).
input exhausted (decompress.c:54) or output space exhausted (bzlib.c:837-838).

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzDecompressInit; not called again after BZ_STREAM_END or an error except via BZ2_bzDecompressEnd (manual.xml:1567-1569; behaviour of further calls after errors is unspecified).
postconditions: next_in/avail_in/total_in_* and next_out/avail_out/total_out_* advanced.
On BZ_STREAM_END, bytes after the stream are not consumed: next_in points just past the byte containing the last bit of the combined CRC (verified).
Output of a block is written before its CRC is checked, so corrupt bytes may already be in next_out on BZ_DATA_ERROR.
side_effects: bzalloc once per stream when the header is read (decompress.c:211-220).
AssertH 4001 if the saved state is invalid (decompress.c:614); 4002 and 6001 unreachable (decompress.c:617, bzlib.c:855).
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same stream concurrently; safe on distinct streams.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompressEnd
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompressEnd ( bz_stream *strm )
functions.summary: Free all memory of a decompression stream in any state (also after errors) and set strm->state to NULL.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:865-868).
memory released.

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzDecompressInit and not yet ended (otherwise BZ_PARAM_ERROR if strm->state is NULL or does not point back to strm, bzlib.c:865-868; a dangling non-NULL state is undefined behaviour).
Any decompression state is accepted, including after BZ_STREAM_END or an error.
postconditions: tt/ll16/ll4 (if non-NULL) and the DState passed to bzfree; strm->state == NULL (bzlib.c:870-875).
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzReadOpen
functions.signature: BZFILE* BZ2_bzReadOpen ( int* bzerror, FILE* f, int verbosity, int small, void* unused, int nUnused )
functions.summary: Create a read handle that decompresses one bzip2 stream from f, first consuming nUnused bytes copied from unused.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: f
parameters.meaning: Open for reading, ferror(f)==0, binary mode recommended. Borrowed: never closed by the library; must remain open until BZ2_bzReadClose.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.meaning: Bytes to decompress before reading f; copied into the handle (bzlib.c:1127-1131), so the caller may reuse the buffer on return.
parameters.valid: if NULL, nUnused must be 0; if non-NULL, nUnused in 0..5000

errors.when: f NULL; small not 0/1; verbosity outside 0..4; unused NULL with nUnused != 0; unused non-NULL with nUnused < 0 or > 5000 (bzlib.c:1103-1108) (verified).
ferror(f) (bzlib.c:1110-1111).
malloc of the handle failed (bzlib.c:1113-1115) or from BZ2_bzDecompressInit.
from BZ2_bzDecompressInit (bzlib.c:1133-1135).
handle returned.

preconditions: f non-NULL, open for reading, ferror(f) == 0, ideally in binary mode (manual.xml:1681-1687).
f must stay open and must not be read by the caller until BZ2_bzReadClose; the handle borrows it and never closes it.
unused points to at least nUnused readable bytes (or is NULL with nUnused == 0); it is only read during the call (copied, bzlib.c:1127-1131).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: returns a new malloc-ed handle with writing=False, lastErr=BZ_OK, embedded stream initialised with default allocators and next_in = copied unused bytes (bzlib.c:1117-1140). Nothing has been read from f.
On any error: returns NULL and nothing remains allocated (the handle is freed on the BZ2_bzDecompressInit failure path, bzlib.c:1133-1135).
side_effects: malloc(sizeof(bzFile)); one default bzalloc. No I/O on f.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzReadClose
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzReadClose ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b )
functions.summary: Free a read handle in any state (including after errors). Does not close the FILE*.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: b
parameters.meaning: Handle from BZ2_bzReadOpen; invalid after a successful call.

errors.when: b == NULL (nothing done, bzlib.c:1151-1152) or handle freed.
b is a write handle; nothing freed (bzlib.c:1154-1155).

preconditions: b is NULL (no-op, BZ_OK) or a live handle not yet freed; passing a freed handle is undefined behaviour.
Any read-handle state is accepted, including after errors.
postconditions: Read handle: embedded stream ended if it was initialised and the handle freed (bzlib.c:1157-1159); *bzerror = BZ_OK; b is dangling afterwards.
Write handle: BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR, nothing freed (bzlib.c:1154-1155).
f is never closed.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzReadGetUnused
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzReadGetUnused ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b, void** unused, int* nUnused )
functions.summary: After BZ_STREAM_END, return the bytes read from the file but not consumed by the stream (start of the next stream, if any).

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: b
parameters.meaning: Read handle whose last status is BZ_STREAM_END.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.meaning: Out: pointer into the handle's internal buffer; valid until the next call on b, invalid after BZ2_bzReadClose.

errors.when: b NULL (bzlib.c:1231-1232); unused or nUnused NULL (bzlib.c:1235-1236, checked after the sequence check).
b->lastErr != BZ_STREAM_END (bzlib.c:1233-1234): end not reached, write handle, or a previous successful call (which reset lastErr to BZ_OK) (verified).
*unused = strm.next_in, *nUnused = strm.avail_in (bzlib.c:1238-1240).

preconditions: b is NULL (gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR) or a live handle (not yet passed to BZ2_bzReadClose / BZ2_bzWriteClose*).
Legal only once per stream, after a BZ2_bzRead that reported BZ_STREAM_END (lastErr == BZ_STREAM_END); otherwise BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR (bzlib.c:1233-1234).
unused and nUnused non-NULL (otherwise BZ_PARAM_ERROR, checked after the sequence check, bzlib.c:1235-1236).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: *unused = handle's next_in (points into the handle's internal 5000-byte buffer), *nUnused = avail_in in 0..5000 (bzlib.c:1238-1240).
On BZ_OK: lastErr becomes BZ_OK, so a second call gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.
*unused stays valid only until the next call on b and is invalidated by BZ2_bzReadClose; copy it first.
On errors *unused and *nUnused are not written.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzRead
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzRead ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b, void* buf, int len )
functions.summary: Decompress up to len bytes into buf, reading the file in chunks of up to BZ_MAX_UNUSED bytes; stops at the first end-of-stream.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

functions.returns: Number of bytes stored when *bzerror is BZ_OK (== len) or BZ_STREAM_END (0..len); 0 on every error and for len == 0.

errors.when: b or buf NULL, len < 0 (bzlib.c:1175-1176).
write handle (bzlib.c:1178-1179); or stream already ended (from BZ2_bzDecompress, bzlib.c:1204-1205) (verified).
ferror(f) before or after fread (bzlib.c:1189-1190, 1195-1196).
decompressor wants more input, f at EOF, buf not full (bzlib.c:1207-1209); includes an empty file.
from BZ2_bzDecompress.
from BZ2_bzDecompress (bad stream header).
from BZ2_bzDecompress (block arrays).
end of stream; returns bytes stored (bzlib.c:1211-1213).
buf filled (bzlib.c:1214-1215), or len == 0 (bzlib.c:1181-1182).

preconditions: b is NULL (gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR) or a live handle from BZ2_bzReadOpen that has not been passed to BZ2_bzReadClose; a write handle gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.
buf points to at least len writable bytes.
The FILE* of the handle is still open.
Manual: do not call after an error (manual.xml:1661-1679). Not enforced: lastErr is not consulted.
postconditions: On BZ_OK with return len: buf[0..len-1] holds the next decompressed bytes.

On BZ_STREAM_END: buf[0..ret-1] holds the last bytes of the stream (ret may be 0); lastErr == BZ_STREAM_END, so BZ2_bzReadGetUnused becomes legal; further calls give BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR (bzlib.c:1204-1205).
On other errors the return is 0 but buf may already have been written.
Over-read input bytes (up to 5000) stay in the handle for BZ2_bzReadGetUnused.
side_effects: fread on f; fgetc/ungetc on f to test EOF (myfeof, bzlib.c:906-912); bzalloc via the stream; stderr at verbosity >= 2.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzWriteOpen
functions.signature: BZFILE* BZ2_bzWriteOpen ( int* bzerror, FILE* f, int blockSize100k, int verbosity, int workFactor )
functions.summary: Create a write handle that compresses data written with BZ2_bzWrite into f.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: f
parameters.meaning: Open for writing, ferror(f)==0. Borrowed: never closed by the library.

errors.when: f NULL or blockSize100k/workFactor/verbosity out of range (bzlib.c:928-932) (verified).
ferror(f) (bzlib.c:934-935).
malloc of handle failed (bzlib.c:937-939) or from BZ2_bzCompressInit.
from BZ2_bzCompressInit (bzlib.c:951-954).
handle returned; all compression memory allocated.

preconditions: f non-NULL, open for writing, ferror(f) == 0, ideally in binary mode (manual.xml:1681-1687).
f must stay open until the handle is closed with BZ2_bzWriteClose/BZ2_bzWriteClose64; the caller should not write to f in between. The handle never closes f.
postconditions: On BZ_OK: returns a new malloc-ed handle with writing=True, lastErr=BZ_OK, embedded compression stream initialised (all compression memory allocated, bzlib.c:938-958). Nothing written to f yet.
On any error: returns NULL and nothing remains allocated (bzlib.c:951-954).
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzWrite
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzWrite ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b, void* buf, int len )
functions.summary: Compress all len bytes of buf, fwrite-ing compressed output to f as it becomes available.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: buf
parameters.meaning: Input bytes; not retained after return.

errors.when: b or buf NULL, len < 0 (bzlib.c:974-975).
read handle (bzlib.c:976-977) (verified); or from BZ2_bzCompress if the stream is no longer RUNNING (e.g. after a failed close).
ferror(f) on entry (bzlib.c:978-979) or short/failed fwrite (bzlib.c:996-999).
any result other than BZ_RUN_OK is passed through (bzlib.c:990-992).
len == 0 (bzlib.c:981-982) or all input consumed (bzlib.c:1002-1003).

preconditions: b is NULL (gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR) or a live write handle from BZ2_bzWriteOpen, not yet freed by BZ2_bzWriteClose*; a read handle gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.
buf points to at least len readable bytes; it is only read during the call.
The handle's FILE* is still open.
Manual: do not call after an error (manual.xml:1661-1679). Not enforced: lastErr is not consulted, and lastErr is reset to BZ_OK on entry (bzlib.c:973).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: all len bytes have been consumed into the compressor (avail_in == 0, bzlib.c:1002-1003); compressed output produced so far has been fwrite-n to f; up to one block of input may still be buffered inside the compressor.
On BZ_OK the handle's lastErr is BZ_OK; on an error lastErr holds the code, which makes a later BZ2_bzWriteClose(abandon=0) skip the trailer.
On BZ_IO_ERROR or a BZ2_bzCompress error, an unspecified prefix of buf has been consumed and f may hold a partial stream.
side_effects: fwrite to f in chunks of up to 5000 bytes; stderr output at verbosity >= 2; AssertH paths of BZ2_bzCompress.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzWriteClose
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzWriteClose ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b, int abandon, unsigned int* nbytes_in, unsigned int* nbytes_out )
functions.summary: Exactly BZ2_bzWriteClose64(bzerror, b, abandon, nbytes_in, NULL, nbytes_out, NULL) (bzlib.c:1016-1017): finish (unless abandon), fflush, report low 32 bits of the counts, free the handle.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: abandon
parameters.meaning: Non-zero: do not finish or fflush, just free.

parameters.name: nbytes_in
parameters.meaning: Out: low 32 bits of uncompressed bytes consumed.

parameters.name: nbytes_out
parameters.meaning: Out: low 32 bits of compressed bytes produced.

errors.when: identical behaviour.

preconditions: Same as BZ2_bzWriteClose64: b is NULL or a live handle not yet freed.
postconditions: Same as BZ2_bzWriteClose64 with nbytes_in_hi32 = nbytes_out_hi32 = NULL: *nbytes_in / *nbytes_out (if non-NULL) receive the low 32 bits of the counts.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzWriteClose64
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzWriteClose64 ( int* bzerror, BZFILE* b, int abandon, unsigned int* nbytes_in_lo32, unsigned int* nbytes_in_hi32, unsigned int* nbytes_out_lo32, unsigned int* nbytes_out_hi32 )
functions.summary: Unless abandoning: fail with BZ_IO_ERROR if ferror(f) is set, write the trailer if no previous error was recorded (lastErr == BZ_OK), and fflush f. Then report 64-bit byte counts and free the handle. Does not fclose f.

parameters.name: bzerror
parameters.meaning: Out: status code; also stored in the handle's lastErr when the handle is known (BZ_SETERR, bzlib.c:886-890).

parameters.name: abandon
parameters.meaning: Non-zero: skip finishing and fflush; always frees.

errors.when: b == NULL: nothing done (bzlib.c:1033-1034).
read handle; not freed (bzlib.c:1035-1036).

!abandon && ferror(f) on entry (bzlib.c:1040-1041; the usual state after BZ_IO_ERROR from BZ2_bzWrite, so no flush and no trailer happen), short fwrite while finishing (bzlib.c:1060-1061), or fflush error (bzlib.c:1068-1071); handle NOT freed.
while finishing (bzlib.c:1053-1054); handle NOT freed.

handle freed (bzlib.c:1083-1085): always with abandon != 0; with abandon == 0 only if ferror(f) was clear on entry, finishing (when lastErr == BZ_OK) succeeded and fflush succeeded. After an earlier non-I/O error (lastErr != BZ_OK, ferror clear) BZ_OK is reported although no trailer was written.

preconditions: b is NULL (no-op, BZ_OK) or a handle from BZ2_bzWriteOpen that has not been freed; a read handle gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.
The handle's FILE* is still open.
postconditions: Count pointers that are non-NULL are set to 0 first (bzlib.c:1043-1046), then to the stream totals on the freeing path (bzlib.c:1074-1081); on the early returns at bzlib.c:1033-1041 they are not written.
If !abandon, ferror(f) clear on entry and lastErr == BZ_OK: end-of-stream marker and combined CRC written (bzlib.c:1048-1066), f fflush-ed, handle freed, BZ_OK.
If !abandon and ferror(f) set on entry (the usual state after BZ_IO_ERROR from BZ2_bzWrite, bzlib.c:978-979, 996-999): BZ_IO_ERROR at bzlib.c:1040-1041; no trailer, no fflush, handle NOT freed.

If !abandon, ferror(f) clear and lastErr != BZ_OK (e.g. after BZ_PARAM_ERROR or BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR from BZ2_bzWrite): no trailer is written (f holds an incomplete stream); f is fflush-ed; if fflush succeeds the handle is freed and BZ_OK reported, otherwise BZ_IO_ERROR and the handle stays allocated (bzlib.c:1068-1072).
If abandon != 0 (and b is a write handle): no trailer, no fflush, handle always freed, BZ_OK.
Whenever the handle was not freed, a further call with abandon=1 is needed to release it (as BZ2_bzclose does, bzlib.c:1525-1528).
f is never closed.
side_effects: fwrite and fflush on f; bzfree/free; stderr at verbosity >= 2 while finishing.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same handle concurrently. Uses stdio on the caller's FILE*; malloc/free for the handle.

functions.name: BZ2_bzBuffToBuffCompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzBuffToBuffCompress ( char* dest, unsigned int* destLen, char* source, unsigned int sourceLen, int blockSize100k, int verbosity, int workFactor )
functions.summary: Compress source[0..sourceLen-1] into one complete stream in dest[0..*destLen-1] in a single call.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.meaning: Output buffer; never written at or beyond dest[*destLen].

parameters.name: destLen
parameters.meaning: In: capacity. Out (BZ_OK only): compressed size (bzlib.c:1287).

errors.when: NULL pointer or range violation (bzlib.c:1262-1267).
from BZ2_bzCompressInit.
from BZ2_bzCompressInit.
BZ2_bzCompress(BZ_FINISH) returned BZ_FINISH_OK: output did not fit; *destLen unchanged (bzlib.c:1283, 1291-1293) (verified).
no progress in the FINISH call: sourceLen == 0 and *destLen == 0 (bzlib.c:1284, 457) (verified).
complete stream in dest.

preconditions: dest points to at least *destLen writable bytes; source to at least sourceLen readable bytes; the two must not overlap (not checked; uncertain what happens if they do).
dest, destLen and source non-NULL; blockSize100k 1..9, verbosity 0..4, workFactor 0..250 (else BZ_PARAM_ERROR, bzlib.c:1262-1267).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: dest[0..*destLen-1] holds one complete .bz2 stream for source[0..sourceLen-1] and *destLen is its length (bzlib.c:1287).
On every other return *destLen is unchanged; dest[0..old *destLen-1] may hold partial output (BZ_OUTBUFF_FULL).
No memory remains allocated on any return (BZ2_bzCompressEnd on every path after Init, bzlib.c:1288-1297).
side_effects: Stack bz_stream with default allocators (malloc/free), freed on every path after Init; stderr at verbosity >= 2.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress ( char* dest, unsigned int* destLen, char* source, unsigned int sourceLen, int small, int verbosity )
functions.summary: Decompress the first bzip2 stream in source[0..sourceLen-1] into dest[0..*destLen-1] with one BZ2_bzDecompress call; trailing bytes are ignored.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.meaning: Output buffer; never written at or beyond dest[*destLen]; may hold partial data on error.

parameters.name: destLen
parameters.meaning: In: capacity. Out (BZ_OK only): decompressed size (bzlib.c:1335).

errors.when: NULL pointer or range violation (bzlib.c:1313-1317).
from BZ2_bzDecompressInit.
from BZ2_bzDecompressInit or block allocation.
from BZ2_bzDecompress (verified).
from BZ2_bzDecompress (verified).
BZ2_bzDecompress returned BZ_OK with output space left (bzlib.c:1340-1342) (verified).
BZ2_bzDecompress returned BZ_OK with avail_out == 0 (bzlib.c:1343-1345) (verified); also for truncated input that exactly fills dest.
first stream decoded; bytes after it ignored (verified).

preconditions: dest points to at least *destLen writable bytes; source to at least sourceLen readable bytes; no overlap (not checked).
dest, destLen and source non-NULL; small 0 or 1; verbosity 0..4 (else BZ_PARAM_ERROR, bzlib.c:1313-1317).
postconditions: On BZ_OK: dest[0..*destLen-1] holds the decompressed first stream of source and *destLen is its length (bzlib.c:1335); bytes after that stream are ignored.
On every other return *destLen is unchanged; dest may hold partial (possibly corrupt) output.
No memory remains allocated on any return (BZ2_bzDecompressEnd on every path after Init, bzlib.c:1336-1350).
side_effects: Stack bz_stream with default allocators, freed on every path after Init; stderr at verbosity >= 2.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzlibVersion
functions.signature: const char * BZ2_bzlibVersion ( void )
functions.summary: Return the static version string BZ_VERSION = "1.0.8, 13-Jul-2019" (bzlib_private.h:39).
functions.returns: Pointer to a static, read-only string; never NULL; must not be freed (verified).
preconditions: none
postconditions: Returns a pointer to the static string BZ_VERSION "1.0.8, 13-Jul-2019" (bzlib_private.h:39); the caller must not modify or free it.
functions.thread_safety: Pure; thread-safe.

functions.name: BZ2_bzopen
functions.signature: BZFILE * BZ2_bzopen ( const char *path, const char *mode )
functions.summary: fopen-like: open path (or stdin/stdout) for compressed reading or writing; returns a BZFILE handle owning the FILE*.

parameters.name: path
parameters.meaning: File name for fopen(path, "rb"/"wb"); NULL or "" means stdin (read) or stdout (write) (bzlib.c:1424-1426).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: Scanned per character (bzlib.c:1405-1419): 'r' read, 'w' write (last wins, default read); 's' small decompression; a digit sets blockSize100k (last wins, default 9, clamped to 1..9 when writing so '0' gives 1; ignored when reading); other characters ignored.

functions.returns: Handle, or NULL if mode is NULL, fopen fails, or BZ2_bzReadOpen/BZ2_bzWriteOpen fails (then the FILE* is fclose-d unless stdin/stdout, bzlib.c:1449-1452). No error code is reported.
preconditions: path is NULL/"" (stdin/stdout) or a NUL-terminated file name; mode is a NUL-terminated string (NULL gives a NULL return, bzlib.c:1404).
postconditions: On success: returns a handle owning a FILE* opened with "rb"/"wb" (bzlib.c:1420-1421); it is fclose-d by BZ2_bzclose unless it is stdin/stdout.
Fixed parameters: verbosity 0, workFactor 30, no unused bytes (bzlib.c:1394-1402).
On failure: returns NULL with no error code; a FILE* opened by the call is closed again unless stdin/stdout (bzlib.c:1449-1452).
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzdopen
functions.signature: BZFILE * BZ2_bzdopen ( int fd, const char *mode )
functions.summary: As BZ2_bzopen but wraps an existing file descriptor with fdopen(fd, "rb"/"wb") (bzlib.c:1434).

parameters.name: fd
parameters.meaning: Open file descriptor. Ownership passes to the handle: BZ2_bzclose fcloses it; it is also closed if fdopen succeeded but the handle could not be created.

functions.returns: Handle or NULL. Always NULL when compiled with BZ_STRICT_ANSI (bzlib.c:1431-1432).
preconditions: fd is an open file descriptor usable with fdopen in the requested direction; mode is a NUL-terminated string (NULL gives a NULL return).
On success ownership of fd passes to the handle: BZ2_bzclose closes it (bzlib.c:1532-1534); the caller must not close fd itself.
postconditions: As BZ2_bzopen, with the FILE* from fdopen(fd, "rb"/"wb") (bzlib.c:1434).
On failure after fdopen succeeded, the FILE* is fclose-d, which also closes fd (bzlib.c:1450). If fdopen itself failed, fd is left open.
With BZ_STRICT_ANSI defined: always returns NULL (bzlib.c:1431-1432).
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzread
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzread ( BZFILE* b, void* buf, int len )
functions.summary: fread-like: 0 if the handle already reached BZ_STREAM_END, else BZ2_bzRead's byte count on BZ_OK/BZ_STREAM_END, else -1.
functions.returns: Bytes read (0 at end of the first stream), or -1 on error.

errors.when: BZ2_bzRead status other than BZ_OK/BZ_STREAM_END (bzlib.c:1486-1490), including write handles.

preconditions: b non-NULL: it is dereferenced unchecked at bzlib.c:1484 (NULL crashes).
b is a live handle; a write handle yields -1. buf points to at least len writable bytes.
postconditions: Returns the number of bytes stored in buf (0..len) when BZ2_bzRead reports BZ_OK or BZ_STREAM_END, else -1 (bzlib.c:1485-1490).
Returns 0 without reading once lastErr == BZ_STREAM_END (bzlib.c:1484).
Only the first stream of the file is read.
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzwrite
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzwrite ( BZFILE* b, void* buf, int len )
functions.summary: fwrite-like: BZ2_bzWrite, returning len on BZ_OK and -1 otherwise.
functions.returns: len on success (0 for len == 0), -1 on any error (bzlib.c:1499-1504).

errors.when: BZ2_bzWrite status != BZ_OK.

preconditions: b is a live write handle (NULL or a read handle yields -1); buf points to at least len readable bytes.
postconditions: Returns len if BZ2_bzWrite reported BZ_OK (all bytes consumed), else -1 (bzlib.c:1499-1504).
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzflush
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzflush ( BZFILE* b )
functions.summary: No-op: returns 0 without flushing the compressor or the FILE* (bzlib.c:1511-1512).
preconditions: none
postconditions: Returns 0; no state changes (bzlib.c:1511-1512).
functions.thread_safety: Thread-safe (does nothing).

functions.name: BZ2_bzclose
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzclose ( BZFILE* b )
functions.summary: fclose-like: finish/free the handle and fclose its FILE* unless it is stdin/stdout; errors are discarded.

parameters.name: b
parameters.meaning: Handle from any open function; invalid afterwards.

preconditions: b is NULL (no-op) or a live handle from BZ2_bzopen/BZ2_bzdopen (b->handle is dereferenced, bzlib.c:1523).
postconditions: Write handle: BZ2_bzWriteClose(&e, b, 0, NULL, NULL); if that did not report BZ_OK, BZ2_bzWriteClose(NULL, b, 1, NULL, NULL), which always frees (bzlib.c:1524-1528).
Read handle: BZ2_bzReadClose (bzlib.c:1530), which frees it.
The handle is freed in both cases; b is dangling afterwards.
FILE* fclose-d unless stdin/stdout (bzlib.c:1532-1534); fclose result and all error codes are discarded.
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzerror
functions.signature: const char * BZ2_bzerror ( BZFILE *b, int *errnum )
functions.summary: Return a static string for the handle's last status and store the code (positive codes mapped to 0) in *errnum.

parameters.name: errnum
parameters.meaning: Out: lastErr, or 0 if lastErr > 0; dereferenced unchecked.

functions.returns: One of "OK", "SEQUENCE_ERROR", "PARAM_ERROR", "MEM_ERROR", "DATA_ERROR", "DATA_ERROR_MAGIC", "IO_ERROR", "UNEXPECTED_EOF", "OUTBUFF_FULL", "CONFIG_ERROR" (bzlib.c:1542-1559); after BZ_STREAM_END it returns "OK" and 0 (verified).
preconditions: b non-NULL and a live handle not yet closed (b->lastErr is read unchecked, bzlib.c:1564).
errnum non-NULL (written unchecked, bzlib.c:1567).
postconditions: *errnum = lastErr if it is <= 0, else 0 (bzlib.c:1566-1567).
Returns the static string bzerrorstrings[-*errnum] (bzlib.c:1542-1559, 1568); the caller must not modify or free it.
The handle is not modified.
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_blockSort
functions.signature: void BZ2_blockSort ( EState* s )
functions.summary: Burrows-Wheeler sort of the current compression block; sets s->origPtr. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: s
parameters.meaning: Compressor state with s->nblock > 0 block bytes in arr2 and work arrays sized as by BZ2_bzCompressInit (blocksort.c:1019-1030).

preconditions: s is a live EState set up by BZ2_bzCompressInit (s->ptr = arr1, s->block = (UChar*)arr2, s->ftab sized 65537 words, bzlib.c:177-179, 198, 201).
s->nblock > 0 and ((UChar*)s->arr2)[0..nblock-1] holds the block; arr2 has room for nblock + BZ_N_OVERSHOOT words (blocksort.c:1019-1030).
s->workFactor and s->verbosity set (read at blocksort.c:1037-1038; workFactor clamped to 1..100 at 1063-1064).
postconditions: arr1[0..nblock-1] holds sorted order; s->origPtr = index of rotation 0; ftab and arr2 beyond the block clobbered (blocksort.c:1025-1030, 1083-1088).
side_effects: fallbackSort if nblock < 10000 or main sort exceeds budget nblock*((clamp(workFactor,1,100)-1)/3) (blocksort.c:1044-1080).
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_compressBlock
functions.signature: void BZ2_compressBlock ( EState* s, Bool is_last_block )
functions.summary: Encode the current block (stream header first if blockNo == 1; end-of-stream marker, combined CRC and byte padding if is_last_block) into s->zbits/s->numZ. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: is_last_block
parameters.meaning: Non-zero to append the stream trailer.

preconditions: s is a live EState set up by BZ2_bzCompressInit and driven by bzlib.c: block bytes in s->block[0..nblock-1] with s->inUse and s->blockCRC maintained by the input routines, s->blockNo the 1-based number of this block (prepare_new_block, bzlib.c:117-126).
Output of the previous block has been fully copied out (state_out_pos == numZ): s->zbits is re-pointed and numZ reset for blocks after the first (compress.c:609, 619).
is_last_block is True exactly for the final call of the stream (also with nblock == 0, which writes only header-if-first and trailer).
postconditions: If nblock > 0: blockCRC finalised and folded into combinedCRC (compress.c:606-608); s->ptr[0..nblock-1] and s->origPtr set by BZ2_blockSort; block header, CRC, randomised bit 0, origPtr, mapping table, selectors, code tables and coded data appended to s->zbits[0..numZ-1] (compress.c:630-653).
If blockNo == 1: bit buffer reset and stream header 'BZh' + ('0'+blockSize100k) emitted first (compress.c:622-628).
If is_last_block: end-of-stream magic and combinedCRC appended and the bit buffer flushed to a byte boundary (compress.c:657-666); otherwise up to 31 bits may remain in bsBuff.
The block contents in arr2 beyond nblock and ftab are clobbered; arr1 reused for the MTF values.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_bsInitWrite
functions.signature: void BZ2_bsInitWrite ( EState* s )
functions.summary: Reset the compressor's bit buffer: s->bsLive = 0, s->bsBuff = 0 (compress.c:39-40). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
preconditions: s non-NULL, points to a writable EState.
postconditions: s->bsLive == 0 and s->bsBuff == 0 (compress.c:39-40); nothing else changed.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths ( UChar *len, Int32 *freq, Int32 alphaSize, Int32 maxLen )
functions.summary: Compute Huffman code lengths limited to maxLen by repeatedly halving weights (huffman.c:79-147). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: freq
parameters.meaning: Symbol frequencies (0 treated as 1); read only.

parameters.name: maxLen
parameters.meaning: Maximum code length; library passes 17 (compress.c:450-451). Must be large enough for alphaSize or the loop does not terminate (uncertain exact bound; unchecked).

preconditions: 1 <= alphaSize <= BZ_MAX_ALPHA_SIZE (258): internal arrays are sized BZ_MAX_ALPHA_SIZE + 2 (huffman.c:75-77).
len has room for alphaSize entries; freq has alphaSize readable entries (read only).
maxLen large enough that a length-limited code for alphaSize symbols exists; not checked (exact bound uncertain). The library uses maxLen = 17 (compress.c:450-451).
postconditions: len[0..alphaSize-1] holds Huffman code lengths, each <= maxLen; zero frequencies are treated as 1, so every symbol gets a non-zero length (huffman.c:79-147).
freq is unchanged.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbAssignCodes
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbAssignCodes ( Int32 *code, UChar *length, Int32 minLen, Int32 maxLen, Int32 alphaSize )
functions.summary: Assign canonical Huffman codes: by increasing length then symbol index, consecutive values, shifted left between lengths (huffman.c:160-165). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
preconditions: code has room for alphaSize entries; length has alphaSize readable entries.
minLen <= maxLen; for a valid prefix code, the lengths in minLen..maxLen satisfy Kraft's inequality (as produced by BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths); not checked.
postconditions: For each i with minLen <= length[i] <= maxLen, code[i] is the canonical code: codes assigned in increasing length, then increasing symbol index, consecutive integers, shifted left by one between lengths (huffman.c:160-165).
Entries whose length is outside minLen..maxLen are not written; length is unchanged.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbCreateDecodeTables
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbCreateDecodeTables ( Int32 *limit, Int32 *base, Int32 *perm, UChar *length, Int32 minLen, Int32 maxLen, Int32 alphaSize )
functions.summary: Build canonical decoding tables limit/base/perm from code lengths (huffman.c:180-199); performs no validation. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
preconditions: Every length[i] (i < alphaSize) in minLen..maxLen and <= 21: base[length[i]+1] is incremented for every i and only base/limit[0..BZ_MAX_CODE_LEN-1] (23 entries) are cleared and summed (huffman.c:185-190); the decoder guarantees 1..20 (decompress.c:327).
limit and base have room for at least BZ_MAX_CODE_LEN (23) entries; perm for alphaSize entries; alphaSize <= 258.
postconditions: perm[0..alphaSize-1] lists the symbols sorted by (length, index) (huffman.c:180-183).

limit[i] (minLen <= i <= maxLen) is the largest canonical code of length i (or one less than the first code of length i if there is none); base[i] is the offset such that perm[code - base[len]] is the symbol (huffman.c:185-199). Other entries of base/limit[0..22] hold intermediate counts or 0.
length is unchanged.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_decompress
functions.signature: Int32 BZ2_decompress ( DState* s )
functions.summary: Resumable parser for one stream: header, block headers, tables, Huffman/MTF data, inverse-BWT setup; returns when it needs input, has a block ready (state BZ_X_OUTPUT) or reaches end of stream. Does not check CRCs. Locals are saved in s->save_* on every return except the return True inside BZ_GET_FAST/BZ_GET_SMALL at decompress.c:557-579 (apparently unreachable after the cftab checks; uncertain). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.returns: BZ_OK (input exhausted mid-parse, decompress.c:54; or a block is fully decoded and s->state = BZ_X_OUTPUT, decompress.c:584), BZ_STREAM_END (end-of-stream marker and stored combined CRC read, s->state = BZ_X_IDLE, decompress.c:611-612), BZ_DATA_ERROR_MAGIC, BZ_DATA_ERROR or BZ_MEM_ERROR (see errors). All returns go through RETURN -> save_state_and_return (decompress.c:619-646) except the BZ_GET_FAST/BZ_GET_SMALL `return True` noted in the summary.

errors.when: Stream header: first byte != 'B', second != 'Z', third != 'h', or block-size byte outside '1'..'9' (decompress.c:198-208).
bzalloc of the block buffer fails right after the stream header: ll16 or ll4 NULL when small, tt NULL otherwise (decompress.c:211-220).
Block header magic byte other than 0x31 41 59 26 53 59 (decompress.c:225-235) or end-of-stream magic byte other than 0x72 45 38 50 90 (decompress.c:591-599).
origPtr < 0 or > 10 + 100000*blockSize100k (decompress.c:261-264); no byte values in use (nInUse == 0, decompress.c:283).
nGroups outside 2..6 (decompress.c:288); nSelectors < 1 (decompress.c:290); a unary selector value >= nGroups (decompress.c:297).
Coding-table delta walks a code length outside 1..20 (decompress.c:327).
Huffman decoding (GET_MTF_VAL): more groups needed than nSelectors, code longer than 20 bits, or decoded index outside 0..BZ_MAX_ALPHA_SIZE-1 (decompress.c:75-101).
RUNA/RUNB run length N >= 2*1024*1024 (decompress.c:396); block would exceed nblockMAX = 100000*blockSize100k symbols (decompress.c:410, 417, 427).
After the block: origPtr >= nblock (decompress.c:497-498); an unzftab entry outside 0..nblock, a cftab entry outside 0..nblock, or cftab descending (decompress.c:502-522).

preconditions: s was set up by BZ2_bzDecompressInit and s->state >= BZ_X_MAGIC_1 (the only caller, BZ2_bzDecompress, checks this, bzlib.c:841-842); s->strm->next_in/avail_in describe the available input.
postconditions: On BZ_OK with s->state == BZ_X_OUTPUT the block is decoded into tt or ll16/ll4 and the inverse-BWT start (tPos, nblock_used, k0, CRC init) is set up (decompress.c:524-581); otherwise s->state names the GET_* point to resume at.
On BZ_STREAM_END s->state == BZ_X_IDLE and s->storedCombinedCRC holds the stored combined CRC; the caller compares it (bzlib.c:843-849).
On error the stream is left mid-parse; BZ2_bzDecompress returns the code to the user unchanged (bzlib.c:851).
side_effects: default case of the state switch: AssertH 4001 (decompress.c:614); falling out of the switch: AssertH 4002 (decompress.c:617).
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_indexIntoF
functions.signature: Int32 BZ2_indexIntoF ( Int32 indx, Int32 *cftab )
functions.summary: Binary search: largest nb in 0..255 with cftab[nb] <= indx (bzlib.c:687-698). Pure. Defined __inline__ but externally visible. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
preconditions: cftab points to at least 256 entries, nondecreasing over cftab[1..255] (only cftab[1..255] are read: mid ranges over 1..255).
For a meaningful result, cftab[0] <= indx < cftab[256] (as in the small decoder, where cftab is the cumulative symbol count and 0 <= indx < nblock).
postconditions: Returns the largest nb in 0..255 with nb == 0 or cftab[nb] <= indx (bzlib.c:689-697). Pure: no writes.
functions.thread_safety: Pure; thread-safe.

functions.name: BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail
functions.signature: void BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail ( int errcode )
functions.summary: Fatal internal-error handler: prints a bug report message with errcode and the version to stderr (extra text for 1007) and calls exit(3) (bzlib.c:40-86). Replaced by user-supplied bz_internal_error under BZ_NO_STDIO. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: errcode
parameters.meaning: Assertion number: 1001-1007 blocksort, 2001-2002 huffman, 3001-3007 compress, 4001-4002 decompress, 6001 bzlib.

preconditions: none
postconditions: Never returns: prints the report to stderr and calls exit(3) (bzlib.c:40-86), running atexit handlers but no library cleanup.
side_effects: fprintf(stderr); exit(3) terminates the process without cleanup.
functions.thread_safety: Terminates the process.

data.name: BZ2_crc32Table
data.summary: Lookup table for the MSB-first CRC-32, polynomial 0x04C11DB7, used by BZ_UPDATE_CRC (bzlib_private.h:167-172) for block CRCs (CRC-32/BZIP2). Read-only in practice but not const. Not part of the public API.

data.name: BZ2_rNums
data.summary: Table of run lengths driving the XOR mask used to de-randomise blocks whose randomised bit is set (BZ_RAND_UPD_MASK, bzlib_private.h:133-149). Only used by the decoder; the compressor never randomises. Not const. Not part of the public API.

types.name: bz_stream
types.summary: Caller-allocated stream record shared by caller and library for the low-level API. Must not be moved or copied between Init and End (state->strm back-pointer is checked).

fields.name: next_in
fields.set_by: caller before each Compress/Decompress; library advances it per byte consumed
fields.meaning: Next input byte; not retained between calls.

fields.name: avail_in
fields.set_by: caller; library decrements per byte consumed
fields.meaning: Bytes available at next_in. While FLUSHING/FINISHING it must keep the value the library left (bzlib.c:444, 454).

fields.name: total_in_lo32
fields.meaning: Low 32 bits of total bytes consumed since Init.

fields.name: total_in_hi32
fields.set_by: Init (0); library increments on lo32 wrap
fields.meaning: High 32 bits of total bytes consumed.

fields.name: next_out
fields.set_by: caller; library advances per byte produced
fields.meaning: Where the next output byte goes.

fields.name: avail_out
fields.set_by: caller; library decrements per byte produced
fields.meaning: Free space at next_out (0 allowed; not checked).

fields.name: total_out_lo32
fields.meaning: Low 32 bits of total bytes produced.

fields.name: total_out_hi32
fields.set_by: Init (0); library increments on lo32 wrap
fields.meaning: High 32 bits of total bytes produced.

fields.name: state
fields.set_by: Init (new EState/DState, only on success); End sets NULL
fields.meaning: Opaque private state; NULL or foreign state gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR.

fields.name: bzalloc
fields.set_by: caller before Init; Init stores default_bzalloc (malloc) if NULL
fields.read_by: Init; BZ2_bzDecompress when reading the header
fields.meaning: Allocator, always called as bzalloc(opaque, nbytes, 1); must return NULL on failure; must stay valid until End.

fields.name: bzfree
fields.set_by: caller before Init; Init stores default_bzfree (free, skips NULL) if NULL

types.name: BZFILE
types.summary: typedef void BZFILE; opaque handle of the high-level and zlib-style APIs (absent under BZ_NO_STDIO). Points to private bzFile (bzlib.c:892-902): FILE* handle, 5000-byte buffer, writing flag, embedded bz_stream, lastErr, initialisedOk. Created by BZ2_bzReadOpen/BZ2_bzWriteOpen/BZ2_bzopen/BZ2_bzdopen; freed by BZ2_bzReadClose, a freeing BZ2_bzWriteClose[64], or BZ2_bzclose. Allocated with malloc, not bzalloc.

fields.name: handle
fields.meaning: Underlying file; closed only by BZ2_bzclose and the failure path of BZ2_bzopen/BZ2_bzdopen.

fields.name: writing
fields.meaning: Read vs write handle; mismatch gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.

macros.name: BZ_RUN
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: compress, accept more input later.

macros.name: BZ_FLUSH
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: end the current block after the current avail_in bytes (up to 31 bits stay buffered).

macros.name: BZ_FINISH
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: compress remaining avail_in bytes and terminate the stream.

macros.name: BZ_OK
macros.summary: Success; from BZ2_bzDecompress: needs more input/output space.

macros.name: BZ_RUN_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: RUNNING with progress, or a flush completed.

macros.name: BZ_FLUSH_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: flush in progress.

macros.name: BZ_FINISH_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: finish in progress.

macros.name: BZ_STREAM_END
macros.summary: Compression finished, or end of compressed stream reached with good combined CRC.

macros.name: BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR
macros.summary: Call illegal in current state (see state machines), read/write handle mismatch, or BZ2_bzReadGetUnused before end of stream.

macros.name: BZ_PARAM_ERROR
macros.summary: Bad argument (NULL, out of range, invalid stream); also BZ2_bzCompress BZ_RUN without progress and unknown action in RUNNING.

macros.name: BZ_MEM_ERROR
macros.summary: Allocation failed.

macros.name: BZ_DATA_ERROR
macros.summary: Corrupt compressed data or CRC mismatch.

macros.name: BZ_DATA_ERROR_MAGIC
macros.summary: Stream does not start with BZh1..BZh9.

macros.name: BZ_IO_ERROR
macros.summary: High-level API: ferror set, short fwrite, or fflush failure.

macros.name: BZ_UNEXPECTED_EOF
macros.summary: Input ended before the end-of-stream marker (BZ2_bzRead, BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress).

macros.name: BZ_OUTBUFF_FULL
macros.summary: Buffer utilities: output does not fit in *destLen.

macros.name: BZ_CONFIG_ERROR
macros.summary: Library miscompiled: int/short/char not 4/2/1 bytes (bzlib.c:90-97).

macros.name: BZ_MAX_UNUSED
macros.summary: Size of the high-level staging buffer; max nUnused for BZ2_bzReadOpen and max returned by BZ2_bzReadGetUnused; fread/fwrite chunk size. Only without BZ_NO_STDIO.

macros.name: BZ_NO_STDIO
macros.summary: Removes stdio: no <stdio.h>, no BZ_MAX_UNUSED/BZFILE/high-level/zlib-style functions (BZ2_bzlibVersion stays), no BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail; AssertH calls user-supplied bz_internal_error(int); verbosity output compiled out. Must be defined consistently for library and client.

macros.name: BZ_IMPORT
macros.summary: Defined by clients that load the Windows DLL dynamically (dlltest.c:10). Prevents bzlib.h from defining BZ_EXPORT, so under _WIN32 the declarations become function-pointer variables. No effect elsewhere.

macros.name: BZ_EXPORT
macros.summary: Defined by bzlib.h unless BZ_IMPORT is defined. Under _WIN32 selects BZ_API(f) = WINAPI f and BZ_EXTERN = extern (normal declarations); otherwise unused.

macros.name: BZ_API
macros.value: BZ_API(func): func (non-Windows); WINAPI func (Windows, BZ_EXPORT); (WINAPI * func) (Windows, no BZ_EXPORT)
macros.summary: Wraps each public function name in declarations and definitions; adds the __stdcall convention on Windows or turns declarations into function pointers for dynamic loading.

macros.name: BZ_EXTERN
macros.summary: Storage class prefix of each public declaration.

programs.name: bzip2
programs.summary: Block-sorting file compressor; compresses by default. Mode also derived from argv[0] (bzip2.c:1870-1880). Files: F2F name -> name.bz2 (and back via suffix map .bz2/.bz -> '', .tbz2/.tbz -> .tar, else .out); output created O_EXCL 0600 then mode/owner/times copied from input; input deleted unless -k. Decompression handles concatenated streams.
options: -f, --force: overwrite output (removed first); allow non-regular and hard-linked inputs; with -d copy non-bzip2 data through (also appends whole input after trailing garbage, see md section 9 item 18)
-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2
-L, --license, -V, --version: print version/license to stderr and continue
exit_codes: 0: success (also -h/--help)

1: bad flag, -c with -t, per-file refusals (missing/unreadable input, directory, non-regular file, existing output, hard links, already-compressed suffix, terminal I/O), over-long name, I/O error, out of memory, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP in file-to-file mode
2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))
environment: BZIP2: whitespace-separated tokens prepended to the arguments (bzip2.c:1842)

programs.name: bunzip2
programs.summary: Copy of the bzip2 binary; name contains 'unzip', so the default is decompression (bzip2.c:1870-1872). Same options, exit codes and environment as bzip2.
options: -f, --force: overwrite output (removed first); allow non-regular and hard-linked inputs; with -d copy non-bzip2 data through (also appends whole input after trailing garbage, see md section 9 item 18)
-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2

2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))
environment: BZIP2: whitespace-separated tokens prepended to the arguments (bzip2.c:1842)

-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2
-L, --license, -V, --version: print version/license to stderr and continue
exit_codes: 0: success (also -h/--help)

2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))

programs.name: bzip2recover
programs.summary: Standalone (no libbz2) recovery tool: scans damaged_file bit by bit for block and end-of-stream magics and writes each block of >= 130 bits as a single-block stream rec%05d<basename>[.bz2] (header always BZh9, combined CRC = block CRC) next to the input, created O_EXCL 0600.
options: exactly one argument: the damaged file name (< 1980 characters)
exit_codes: 0: success

1: wrong argument count, name too long, unreadable input, no blocks found, 50000th block/end magic match (BZ_MAX_HANDLED_BLOCKS 50000; currBlock starts at 0 and is checked before increment, bzip2recover.c:398, 441-443), read/write/malloc error, output file already exists

programs.name: bzgrep
programs.summary: sh script: runs grep over 'bzip2 -cdfq' of each file (or stdin), prefixing file names when several files; tries FILE.bz2 if FILE is missing.
options: grep options before the pattern are passed through; -e/-f take the pattern, -A/-B take an argument
exit_codes: 1: no pattern (usage)
otherwise grep's status (stdin) or the last non-zero grep status, else 0

programs.name: bzegrep
programs.summary: Symlink to bzgrep; name ends in 'egrep', so the matcher is ${EGREP-egrep} (bzgrep:13).
exit_codes: as bzgrep

programs.name: bzfgrep
programs.summary: Symlink to bzgrep; name ends in 'fgrep', so the matcher is ${FGREP-fgrep} (bzgrep:14).
exit_codes: as bzgrep

programs.name: bzmore
programs.summary: sh script: pages 'bzip2 -cdfq' of each file (or of stdin if it is not a terminal) through more, prompting between files (e/q quit, s skip).
exit_codes: not explicitly defined; determined by the shell's exit trap (uncertain)

programs.name: bzless
programs.summary: Symlink to bzmore; name ends in 'less', so the pager is less (bzmore:10).
exit_codes: as bzmore

programs.name: bzdiff
programs.summary: sh script: runs diff on one or two files, decompressing *.bz2 operands with bzip2 -cdfq (one file F compares F.bz2 with F; two .bz2 files use a mktemp file).
options: arguments starting with - are passed to the comparator; 1 or 2 existing regular files
exit_codes: 1: missing/non-regular file, no files, more than two files, mktemp failure
otherwise the comparator's status

programs.name: bzcmp
programs.summary: Symlink to bzdiff; name ends in 'cmp', so the comparator is ${CMP-cmp} (bzdiff:18).
exit_codes: as bzdiff
